div.head: V Atr 14.1
div.ab: ⁊ to æghwylces apostoles heahtide fæste man ⁊ freolsige; buton to Philippus ⁊ Iacobus freolse ne beode wé nan fæsten for þam eastorlican freolse.
⁊ to æghwylces apostoles heahtide fæste man georne ⁊ freolsige; butan to Philippus ⁊ Iacobes freolse ne beode we nan fæsten for þam easterlican freolse.
⁊ to æghwilces apostoles heahtida fæste man ⁊ freolsige; butan to Philippus ⁊ Iacobus freolse ne beode we nan fæsten [for þam eastorlican freolse].
And at the festival of every apostle there shall be fasting and festivity, except that at the festival of Philip and James we enjoin no fast [because of the Easter festival].
Und zu jeden Apostels Festzeit faste und feiere man; nur zum Philippus- und Jacobus[-bi G2]-Feste [1. Mai] gebieten wir kein Fasten wegen des österlichen Festes.
And at the festival of every apostle let there be (eager, G2) fasting and feasting; only for the feast of Philip and James [1 May] we command no fast, because of the Easter festival.
